translations.web: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);
translations.bsb: though from my youth I reared him as would a father, and from my mother’s womb I guided the widow—
translations.kjv: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother's womb;)
translations.asv: (Nay, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, And her have I guided from my mother's womb);
